# Spotlightr

Spotlightr is a video hosting and streaming platform that captures leads, updates contacts with engagement data, and provides analytics reporting.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/spotlightr/.

## Actions

- **Get Top Videos** (read-only): Retrieve the top videos from a spotlightr account.
- **Get Video Metrics** (read-only): Retrieve analytics metrics for a specified video.
